create_open_ended_questionnaire: create an OpenEndedQuestionnaire component with questionnaires, player names, and an optional event sequence
reset_questionnaire_component: reset the OpenEndedQuestionnaire component to clear all answers and answered masks
check_questionnaire_completion: check if a specific player or all players have completed the current questionnaire step
get_aggregated_questionnaire_results: get aggregated questionnaire results as a list of dicts with player, dimension, and answer data
plot_questionnaire_results: plot all questionnaire results from a DataFrame by calling plot_results for each questionnaire
